column1: # Every 11th entry by (cell, name) from the 659-entry loaded corpus. Verdict is
# whether the entry belongs in its cell AS THAT CELL'S OWN ANCHOR DEFINES IT.
# Rater: Claude (single, non-blind, knew the hypothesis). All 60 published so
# the judgements can be checked rather than trusted.
# YES = clearly belongs. NO = clearly does not. MARGINAL = defensible loosely.
